evals.title: Menu lists only installed sources
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `status.skills.iterate-from-user` is `true`.
- `status.skills.iterate-from-literature` is `false`.
- `status.skills.iterate-from-skore` is `true`.
- `status.skills.manage-ml-backlog` is `true`.
- `python -m skore_skills model choices` returned one Backlog row, B1.]

What should we explore for the next experiment?
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills status`. - AskUserQuestion with the installed sources only: user idea, mine the last audit, and the Backlog row. One pick. It must NOT: - Offer literature search. - Pick a source for the user. - Write `journal/` or a design note.
expectations: AskUserQuestion with the installed sources only: user idea, mine the last audit, and the Backlog row. One pick.
The response does NOT: Offer literature search.
The response does NOT: Pick a source for the user.
The response does NOT: Write `journal/` or a design note.
The response does NOT: Search the web or read an audit digest in this skill.

evals.title: No installed sources returns to triage
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `iterate-from-user`, `iterate-from-literature`,
  `iterate-from-skore`, and `manage-ml-backlog` are all `false`
  in `status.skills`.
- `status.skills.triage-ml-task` is `true`.]

Explore ideas for the next experiment.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Say in one line that no source skill is installed. - Load `triage-ml-task`. It must NOT: - Invent a user-idea, literature, audit, or backlog procedure. - Write `journal/`.
expectations: Say in one line that no source skill is installed.
The response does NOT: Invent a user-idea, literature, audit, or backlog procedure.

evals.title: Confirmed proposal asks Draft, Park, or Stop
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- The child returned a confirmed Proposal.
- `status.skills.model-ml-pipeline` is `true`.
- `status.skills.manage-ml-backlog` is `true`.
- `status.skills.triage-ml-task` is `true`.]

[iterate-from-user returned a confirmed Proposal for a monotonic
target transform.]
Hand it back.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - AskUserQuestion once: Draft, Park, or Stop. It must NOT: - Write `journal/` or a design note in this skill. - Pick Draft, Park, or Stop for the user. - Load `model-ml-pipeline` before the user picks Draft.
expectations: AskUserQuestion once: Draft, Park, or Stop.
The response does NOT: Write `journal/` or a design note in this skill.
The response does NOT: Pick Draft, Park, or Stop for the user.
The response does NOT: Load `model-ml-pipeline` before the user picks Draft.

evals.title: Question-only return re-shows the source menu
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- No Proposal and no Backlog candidate rows were returned.
- `status.skills.iterate-from-user` is `true`.
- The other source skills are `false`.]

[iterate-from-user answered a project question and returned no
Proposal.]
Continue.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Re-show the source menu. It must NOT: - Ask Draft, Park, or Stop. - Emit a Proposal.
expectations: The response does NOT: Ask Draft, Park, or Stop.
The response does NOT: Emit a Proposal.
